what_it_is.prose: Honeywell Aerospace, the aerospace segment of Honeywell International Inc. (NASDAQ: HON), is a US OEM of aircraft engines, auxiliary power units (APUs), avionics and environmental-control systems. Its most concrete India military-aerospace link is the TPE331-12B turboprop, selected to power Hindustan Aeronautics Limited's HTT-40 basic trainer; Honeywell delivered the first TPE331-12B engines for the HTT-40 in June 2026, an important supply milestone for a flagship Make-in-India trainer programme. Honeywell's TPE331/TFE731 engine families, APUs and avionics also appear across a range of fixed- and rotary-wing platforms in Indian service. Honeywell maintains substantial India operations through Honeywell Technology Solutions and manufacturing/engineering sites in Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Madurai, though India-specific defence order values are not separately disclosed.

deployments_procurement.summary: Honeywell's headline India military-aerospace programme is the TPE331-12B turboprop for HAL's HTT-40 basic trainer, with the first engines delivered in June 2026. Honeywell APUs and avionics feature on other platforms in Indian service; discrete India defence order values are not publicly disclosed.
